# mcpjunction.ai

> The MCP server directory: structured, nightly-updated data on Model Context
> Protocol servers - install hints, categories, licenses, popularity, and
> maintenance status. Data sourced from public GitHub API metadata plus
> editorial review. Not affiliated with Anthropic or the Model Context
> Protocol project.

## Core resources

- [Full directory (JSON)](https://mcpjunction.ai/data/mcp_servers.json): every
  listed server as structured data; regenerated nightly with timestamp
- [Full directory (CSV)](https://mcpjunction.ai/data/mcp_servers.csv): the
  same data as flat rows
- [Dataset page](https://mcpjunction.ai/data): counts, generation timestamp,
  citation format, licensing pointer
- [All categories](https://mcpjunction.ai/categories): the index page
- Server pages at https://mcpjunction.ai/servers/{owner}--{repo}: one page per
  server with install hint, category, topics, license, stars, last-pushed
  date, and security-review status. All pages are enumerated in
  https://mcpjunction.ai/sitemap.xml

## Categories

Every category, in full. Each of these also serves markdown - append `.md` or
send `Accept: text/markdown`.

- [Agent Memory & Knowledge](https://mcpjunction.ai/categories/agent-memory)
- [AI Agents](https://mcpjunction.ai/categories/ai-agents)

- [Uncategorized](https://mcpjunction.ai/categories/uncategorized): servers
  that matched no category term yet. Reviewed weekly. Excluded from the search
  index, but readable and queryable like any other page.

## Topics

- [All topics](https://mcpjunction.ai/topics): servers grouped by GitHub
  repository topic (claude-code, cursor, rag, self-hosted, python, and more).
  A vetted set of widely used tags — owner-assigned strings, not curated
  categories. Every topic page serves markdown the same way category pages
  do, and all are enumerated in the sitemap.

## MCP endpoint (query this directory from your agent)

- https://mcpjunction.ai/mcp - a Model Context Protocol server over streamable
  HTTP (stateless; POST JSON-RPC). Tools: search_servers, get_server,
  list_categories, get_dataset_info. No authentication required.

## Markdown

Server and category pages are available as clean markdown, with no navigation
or styling to strip. Two equivalent ways to get it:

- Send `Accept: text/markdown` to the canonical URL, e.g.
  https://mcpjunction.ai/servers/microsoft--playwright-mcp
- Or append `.md`, e.g.
  https://mcpjunction.ai/servers/microsoft--playwright-mcp.md
  and https://mcpjunction.ai/categories/databases.md

Each HTML page also advertises its variant via
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

## For AI agents

- Directory data is free to read and cite during our launch phase. Attribution
  appreciated: "via mcpjunction.ai".
- Bulk/training use requires a license: https://mcpjunction.ai/licensing
- Machine-readable licensing terms (RSL): https://mcpjunction.ai/license.xml

## Corrections

- Corrections and takedowns: licensing@mcpjunction.ai (see
  https://mcpjunction.ai/licensing); acknowledged within 3 business days
